# Will Barbershop

> Dominican barbershop near VCU in Richmond, Virginia. Fades, tapers, beard sculpting, straight-razor work, curly and textured cuts, designs, platinum color and house calls. Walk-ins welcome, open 7 days. English and Spanish spoken.

## Contact
- Name: Will Barbershop (also listed as "Will Barber" / "Will barber")
- Barber / owner: Wilmer "Will" Montilla
- Address: 904 W Leigh St, Richmond, VA 23220 (a few blocks from VCU, Carver / Jackson Ward area)
- Phone and text: (804) 909-9210
- Website: https://willbarbershoprva.com/ (Spanish: https://willbarbershoprva.com/es/)

## Hours
- Open 7 days a week, 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM
- Sunday hours may be shorter; check Booksy for live availability or call ahead
- Walk-ins are welcome every day

## Services and prices (from the shop's Booksy menu, USD)
- Regular haircut: from $40 (30 min)
- Regular haircut and face steamer: $50 (30 min)
- Master haircut: $100 (1 hr 30 min)
- After 7:00 PM appointment: from $100 (30 min)
- Haircut and beard: from $50 (30 min)
- Haircut, beard and facial steamer: $65 (30 min)
- Kid haircut: $40 (30 min)
- House cut (house call, barber comes to you): $150
- Designs, part lines and bleach / platinum color: priced in shop
- "+" means starting price

## FAQ
- Do you take walk-ins? Yes, walk-ins are welcome every day. Book on Booksy to guarantee a time.
- How much is a haircut? A regular haircut starts at $40; haircut and beard from $50; master haircut $100; kids $40.
- What are the hours? Open 7 days, 9 AM - 8 PM. Sunday hours can be shorter.
- Where do I park? The shop lists a parking space; otherwise use nearby street parking and follow posted signs.
- Do you do house calls? Yes. Book the "House cut" on Booksy for $150.
- Can I get a cut after 7 PM? Yes, by appointment; the "After 7:00 PM" booking starts at $100.
- Do the barbers speak Spanish? Yes. Dominican barbers; English and Spanish spoken.
- Do you accept credit cards? Yes.
- Are you hiring? Yes, the shop has posted openings for barbers ("Vacantes disponibles"). Call (804) 909-9210.
